text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
It has to be Believe. A stable run that 
maintains top speed. No matter how the 
race unfolds, she doesn't falter—that's 
what makes her strong!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"You can't underestimate Durandal either! 
She's got real momentum right now, and 
above all, that breathtaking late burst 
from the back! It's so exhilarating!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O is the fastest! Just 
sheer speed! In races, the fastest 
Umamusume wins!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite pushing herself far beyond her 
limits, Calstone Light O made it safely to 
race day.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I run just like in my 
visualization training, I'll be able to 
hit top speed."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'll pull far ahead and lead all the way 
to the end! With everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Believe. I'm delighted to compete with 
you again today."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
My top speed would never have been 
possible without you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Shall we say the feeling is mutual?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Each taking different paths, they aimed 
to be the fastest. Solely and 
wholeheartedly believing in themselves."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That's why I cannot afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, I shall reach an unprecedented 
speed!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The one who is the quickest is the 
fastest. That is the answer.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"We finally meet on a GⅠ stage, don't we, 
Right O-san?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
While I was stumbling, you defeated Sakura 
Bakushin O and reached the point of being 
called the fastest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
However, that title shall be conceded to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: It's impossible, Durendal.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna outrun a cheetah, just you 
watch!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...... What do you mean, a cheetah?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... There is nothing my holy sword 
cannot cut! Even light itself shall be 
cleaved in two with a single strike!
